quote: Cards synthesised from C1 receptors, C2 precedents and S1 gates.
claim: Community objection cards for the Ratcliffe-on-Soar layout sequence.

cards.who_raised: Parish / neighbouring residents on the south-west approach (C1 homes)
cards.who_affected: Homes nearest the SW generator edge
cards.quote: Standby plant on the residential edge would dominate night-time background levels at the nearest dwellings.
cards.design_response: Move generators to the opposite (north-east) edge by Round 2 and keep halls as a buffer.

cards.who_affected: Receptors with sightlines across the Soar valley
cards.quote: 40 m halls would read as an unbroken industrial cliff from the south-west approaches.
cards.design_response: Drop halls to ≤30 m in Round 1, then step heights down toward the NNE in Round 2.

cards.quote: Bulk and continuous roofscape were cited against comparable large-footprint schemes nearby.
cards.design_response: Hold total hall floor area under the 810,000 m² gate (S1-05) while redistributing plant.

cards.quote: The 720 MW application must remain connectable at the on-site 400 kV substation.
cards.design_response: Keep the on-site substation block; show TEC queue MW and dates beside the application.
